## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: PRs created by /autopilot and /cleanup-feature render a ledger section...

The system SHALL ensure that pRs created by /autopilot and /cleanup-feature render a ledger section generated from choices.json and contract diffs.

#### Scenario: PRs created by /autopilot and /cleanup-feature render a ledger section...

WHEN `reviewer-shaped-prs` is implemented
THEN PRs created by /autopilot and /cleanup-feature render a ledger section generated from choices.json and contract diffs.

### Requirement: A change exceeding the size budget pauses at a contract checkpoint...

The system SHALL ensure that a change exceeding the size budget pauses at a contract checkpoint requesting review from a non-running owner when one exists.

#### Scenario: A change exceeding the size budget pauses at a contract checkpoint...

WHEN `reviewer-shaped-prs` is implemented
THEN A change exceeding the size budget pauses at a contract checkpoint requesting review from a non-running owner when one exists.

### Requirement: In solo mode the checkpoint is skipped and only the ledger section is added

The system SHALL ensure that in solo mode the checkpoint is skipped and only the ledger section is added.

#### Scenario: In solo mode the checkpoint is skipped and only the ledger section is added

WHEN `reviewer-shaped-prs` is implemented
THEN In solo mode the checkpoint is skipped and only the ledger section is added.
